evidence_base.claim: Editor resource, model, rigblock, cEditor, skin, animation-world, and edit-history layouts.
SDK field names, offsets, fixed-vector capacities, function signatures, and request/mode boundaries.
Named editor, model, resource, skin, input, history, animation-world, and request functions.
Mouse position/state is stored transiently and dispatched through mode/tool state.
Mouse interaction reaches tool/actor vtables, changes part state, releases tools, and can commit or undo an edit.
Two history collections, one shared cursor, snapshot commit, history truncation, model restore, and derived-state refresh.
Mode changes update/destroy runtime creature controllers and send animation events.
Controller transforms are runtime pose state; PropertyList uses count plus sequential 0x18-byte entries.

contradictions.issue: EditorData is the requested name, but no EditorData type or symbol is present.
contradictions.resolution: Record a composite model and bound names to exported SDK types.

contradictions.issue: cEditor has 353 SDK fields while decompiler expressions contain generated/untyped fields.
contradictions.resolution: Preserve SDK offsets as structure evidence; do not infer meanings for field_N or generated unions.

contradictions.issue: CommitEditHistory appends small and larger objects, but the larger constructor is unnamed.
contradictions.resolution: Call it cEditorResource-like only as a size/structure hypothesis; keep exact type unresolved.

contradictions.issue: EditorModel::SetColor is named but its available body only returns.
contradictions.resolution: Treat the mutator boundary as named, not behaviorally recovered.

contradictions.issue: EditorModel and cEditorResourceBlock expose similar part/pose/paint concepts, but no body proves they share one serialized representation.
contradictions.resolution: Keep both schemas and mark conversion unresolved.

contradictions.issue: Committed Ghidra snapshot uses 58,757 functions while a prior live read reported 59,245.
contradictions.resolution: Use pinned snapshot/address evidence and retain the count drift as provenance.

contradictions.issue: The live bridge was reachable but had no open program and could not open GUI-mode programs.
contradictions.resolution: Use committed Ghidra exports; no Ghidra mutation or save was attempted.

contradictions.issue: Mode transition effects are statically visible, but current runtime evidence is negative.
contradictions.resolution: Keep lifecycle ordering at INFERRED until a positive trace exists.
